# VENOM Router

> Windows desktop LLM router (Electron 33 + better-sqlite3, v2.0.0): connects
> providers and keys, keeps a live model pool, measures models, and routes
> through venom-lite / venom-pro / venom-max. Source is plain JavaScript, no
> framework, no bundler. Everything on disk is written in English.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): entry point — read order, commands, where things are, non-negotiables
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): boot order, the two SQLite databases, the request lifecycle, all 38 IPC channels
- [docs/CODE_MAP.md](docs/CODE_MAP.md): generated index of every file, plus line landmarks inside the long ones
- [docs/COOKBOOK.md](docs/COOKBOOK.md): recipes for the common changes
- [docs/AGENT_TASK_TEMPLATE.md](docs/AGENT_TASK_TEMPLATE.md): the card to fill in when delegating
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): binding workflow rules for this checkout

## Optional
